name: Intellect Design Arena Ltd.
about: Intellect Design Arena Limited engages in the development, marketing, and sale of integrated banking software systems in India and internationally. It is also involved in supporting the implementation of the systems; and provides help desk support services to users of intellect software systems. In addition, the company provides software development services in the areas of wholesale banking comprising corporate core, commercial loan, payments, liquidity management, investments, virtual accounts, trade and supply chain finance, receivables and collections, treasury, corporate escrow deposits, and corporate banking exchange. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~22% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~11% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 11.8% cost of equity).
PE of 23 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 38), though that is a short history to judge by.
